entry_encoding: (event_time: float, driver_id: str, next_lap: int, next_age: int); heap orders on (event_time, driver_id); payload never compared (driver_id unique among live entries)

heap_growth.periodic_compaction: not introduced: no evidence requires it; growth impossible by construction
heap_growth.workload: 200 sims x ~1120 events, ordinary_early, production config

initial_fill: roster-order schedule loop kept byte-identical (preserves RNG cursor order); heappush per driver maintains the invariant incrementally, no heapify needed
loop: while ok and len(finished) < n and steps <= bound: steps += 1; if not heap: break; event_t = heap[0][0]; drain all entries with entry[0] == event_t via heappop into batch; process batch in pop order (== ascending driver_id for ties); terminal drivers record finished without push, others heappush their successor
module: heapq (CPython stdlib, C-accelerated heappush/heappop); no new dependency, no threads, no vectorization, no API change
rescheduling: pop-then-push preserves the legacy single-live-entry-per-driver invariant; reschedule failures set ok=False and break the batch exactly as legacy
stale_entry_handling: stale entries are impossible by construction (no lazy invalidation, no generation metadata): each driver holds at most one live heap entry, popped before its successor is pushed; measured stale pops = 0; no stale event may execute and none can exist
